groups.name: simplex_rounding
groups.domain: All k=1..4 rational simplex points with denominator 1..5; output denominators 1..9.

groups.name: bayesian_perturbation
groups.domain: All two-cell quarter-grid priors and likelihood vectors with coordinates 1/4,1/2,3/4,1.

groups.name: exact_profile_rounding
groups.domain: Four sensor cells; every binary report history through length 5; denominators 8,16,64,256,65536.

groups.name: within_cell_likelihood_error
groups.domain: Four raw worlds in two target cells; differing likelihoods within cells, adaptive matched experiment choice, every report history through length 4; N=8,64,4096.

groups.name: rare_evidence_control
groups.domain: Two worlds with d=1/(4N), N=2,4,16,64; impossible observations deliberately rejected.

groups.name: block_comparison
groups.domain: Four rational norm-bound families, all sign-switching words through length 5, initial coordinates -1,0,1, and exact or 1/8-displaced initialization.

groups.name: infinite_series_and_feedback
groups.domain: Positive stable comparison families and finite partial sums through 30; exact unstable-output and two-way-feedback formulas through 10.

groups.name: joint_risk_certificate
groups.domain: Eight-world sensor, all histories through three reports, future horizons 0..5, N=64,256,65536; exact risks for both numerical decisions.

groups.name: precision_choice
groups.domain: Horizons 0..4, likelihood floors 1/2 and 1/4, model errors 0 and 1/128, and tolerance 1/10 when its strict prerequisite holds.

groups.name: input_boundaries
groups.domain: Invalid probability vectors, record dimensions, denominators, likelihoods and quantitative premises.

groups.name: consolidated_example_values
groups.domain: The exact values printed in the first-edition sensor-to-predictor example.

non_claim: These are bounded project-authored checks, not proofs by enumeration, independent validation, or trained-agent results.
